title: Best AC Under Rs 35,000 in India (2026): 1.5 Ton Split Inverter Picks For Indian Summers
description: Compare the best ACs under Rs 35,000 in India by tonnage, ISEER rating, copper coil and smart features - five inverter picks for Indian summers.
short_desc: Five 1 and 1.5 ton inverter split ACs under Rs 35,000 ranked by ISEER, copper coil, smart features and Indian summer reliability.

headings.text: What actually matters in an AC under Rs 35,000 in 2026

cta.headline: Looking for a smaller room AC?
cta.sub: Our 1 ton AC guide covers the best 1 ton inverter split ACs under Rs 30,000 for rooms up to 120 sq ft.

tldr_pick: The LG 1.5 Ton 5 Star AI Convertible Split AC (PS-Q18ZNZE) is the best AC under Rs 35,000 in India for most buyers in 2026: a 5-star ISEER 5.20 inverter with AI Convertible mode that adjusts cooling capacity, dual inverter compressor, 100% copper coil, and LG's 10-year compressor warranty.
key_takeaways: 1.5 ton is the right capacity for 120-180 sq ft rooms in Indian homes - the most common Indian bedroom size. 1 ton under-cools; 2 ton over-cools and wastes electricity.
5-star ISEER (5.20+) saves Rs 3,000-5,000/year versus 3-star on typical 8-month Indian AC use. The price premium is Rs 2,000-4,000 - it pays back in 6-12 months.
100% copper coil is non-negotiable - aluminium coils corrode within 3-5 years in Indian humidity and cost Rs 6,000-8,000 to replace. Every credible brand offers copper in 2026.
AI Convertible / dual inverter compressors extend savings - they ramp up and down smoothly instead of hard-cycling, saving 15-25% on the electricity bill versus fixed-speed compressors.
who_for: Indian buyers who want a 1.5 ton 5-star inverter split AC for a 120-180 sq ft bedroom or small hall, for 8 months of Indian summer use. Not aimed at buyers who need a 2 ton AC for large halls, or buyers who only need a 3-4 month seasonal AC and can stretch to a window AC under Rs 25,000.
methodology: We compared 12 popular 1 and 1.5 ton split inverter ACs under Rs 35,000 available in India in 2026 against the three most common Indian use cases: 8-month hot-season use (April-November) in North/Central India, year-round use in coastal South India, and 4-month use in hill stations. ISEER rating, copper coil, compressor warranty, smart features (Wi-Fi, AI Convertible, geo-fencing), and service network were weighted equally. Models with no confirmed India launch, no copper coil, or fixed-speed compressors were excluded.

faq.q: Is a 1.5 ton AC enough for a typical Indian bedroom?
faq.a: Yes for 120-180 sq ft rooms. Most Indian bedrooms (10x12 to 12x15 feet) fall in this range. For larger rooms (15x18 feet and above), step up to a 2 ton AC. For smaller rooms (under 100 sq ft), a 1 ton AC is enough and saves Rs 3,000-5,000 on the unit plus lower electricity bills.

faq.q: What is ISEER and why does it matter?
faq.a: ISEER (Indian Seasonal Energy Efficiency Ratio) is the BEE's energy-efficiency metric for ACs - the higher the ISEER, the less electricity the AC uses. A 5-star ISEER 5.20 AC uses about 25-30% less electricity than a 3-star ISEER 3.30 AC. On typical 8-month Indian use, the electricity savings are Rs 3,000-5,000 per year. The price premium for 5-star is Rs 2,000-4,000 - it pays back in 6-12 months.

Yes. Copper coil ACs last 10-12 years in Indian humidity. Aluminium coil ACs corrode within 3-5 years and replacing the coil costs Rs 6,000-8,000. Every credible brand (LG, Daikin, Voltas, Carrier, Bluestar, Lloyd, Hitachi) offers copper coil across their 2026 lineups. Off-brand aluminium-coil ACs at Rs 22,000-26,000 are a false economy.

faq.q: What is AI Convertible mode and is it worth it?
faq.a: AI Convertible mode (LG, Carrier) adjusts the compressor's cooling capacity based on room temperature, humidity, and occupancy. Instead of running at full power and hard-cycling on/off, it ramps up and down smoothly. The electricity saving is 15-25% versus a fixed-capacity inverter. It also reduces compressor wear, extending the 10-year warranty life. Worth the Rs 1,500-2,500 price premium over non-AI inverter ACs.

faq.q: How important is the compressor warranty?
faq.a: Very. The compressor is the most expensive part of an AC - replacement costs Rs 8,000-12,000 plus installation. Every AC in this list has a 10-year compressor warranty (the longest available in India). The warranty is conditional on annual servicing (Rs 600-900 per visit) - missing annual servicing can void it. Keep the service receipts.
